findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md:37 states B-b5c0 lifecycle metadata under .lattice/story/actives/B-b5c0/* is allowed story-scoped provenance, but line 120 says this roadmap story does not edit story JSON. Because the branch includes Lattice story JSON provenance, the Non-Goals wording should narrow this to product/material changes or direct/manual story JSON edits to avoid contradicting the top-level scope boundary.

docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md:37-40 correctly says B-b5c0 lifecycle metadata under .lattice/story/actives/B-b5c0/* is allowed story-scoped provenance, but line 120 still says this roadmap story does not edit story JSON or runtime metadata. Because this branch includes Lattice story metadata/evidence commits as workflow provenance, the Non-Goals wording should narrow that claim to product/material changes or direct/manual story JSON edits so it does not contradict the top boundary.
